title: webPushTokens
responsibility: Creates the application server key and signs the VAPID and Hub sender tokens.

inputs.name: vapidAuthorization.config
inputs.description: The application server key pair and the Hub origin from web-push.json.

inputs.name: vapidAuthorization.now
inputs.description: The current time in epoch milliseconds.

inputs.name: hubSenderAuthorization.config
inputs.description: The application server key pair and the Hub origin from web-push.json.

inputs.name: hubSenderAuthorization.now
inputs.description: The current time in epoch milliseconds.

outputs.name: generateWebPushKeys
outputs.description: A new P-256 key pair, base64url.

outputs.name: vapidAuthorization
outputs.description: The VAPID header, audience limited to the push service.

outputs.name: hubSenderAuthorization
outputs.description: A two-minute bearer for the Hub only, with its own token type.
